notes.title: The Last Roman Village 2
notes.content:
🚨 The Last Roman Village 2 is in development!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34133770/5ec5ce52625674dd0297300c59fde5a5d5485bc0.png[/img]
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1192830/The_Last_Roman_Village_2/]Wishlist the sequel – The Last Roman Village 2[/url]

[b]
🛡️ What’s New in The Last Roman Village 2[/b]

    [list]
[*] Full 3D visuals – Stunning Roman environments, detailed characters, and epic battles brought to life in a rich 3D world
[*] Build your village in full depth – Place, rotate, and upgrade buildings with full camera control
[*] Real-time combat – Play as the General, fight with sword and magic, and lead your army from the front lines
[*] Open world campaign map – Conquer new territories, unlock regions, and discover secrets on a dynamic world map
[*] Magic system & artifacts – Unlock rare spells, scrolls, and legendary treasures to gain the upper hand
[*] Epic enemies & bosses – Battle orcs, trolls, ghouls, dragons, and God Orcus himself in massive showdowns
[*] Cards of Destiny system – Spin for powerful boosts, soldiers, rare scrolls, and risks after each boss fight
[*] Meaningful choices – Decisions that impact your journey, allies, and story outcomes
[*] Atmospheric world – Dynamic weather, immersive soundtrack, and cinematic moments
[*] Planned multiplayer & surprises – More features will be revealed as the game develops
[*] No microtransactions, no pay-to-win — one full experience
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX and Master Volume control added
notes.content:
[b]- FIXED BUG: In rare cases, enemies get stuck and this prevents completing current wave.[/b]
[b]- Added Master Volume control option in Pause Menu.[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]NEW BUILDING:[/b][/h3]
 + [b][i]Dragon Nest[/i][/b] - can create 2 dragon types (small dragon and elder dragon) which do fire damage to multiple enemies.

[h3][b]NEW ENEMIES:[/b][/h3]
 + [b][i]Ice Monk[/i][/b] - make magic damage that ignore soldiers armor. Has fire, ice and poison resistance)
 + [b][i]Fire Witch[/i][/b] - low range enemy, that make fire damage. Has fire resistance

[b]Bug Fixes and improvements[/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.7
notes.content:
UPDATE 1.0.7 INCLUDES:

+ Fix CRITICAL BUG after last update, preventing player to load Buildings/Soldiers data correctly after exit game. (This can cause missing buildings, soldiers, stats..)
+ small UI fix


UPDATE 1.0.6 INCLUDES:

 + Multi Language Support included. Currently we have added translations for the following languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese and Korean

notes.title: v 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[b]Walls[/b]
    - walls level 3,4,5 HP reduced

[b]Enemies & Bosses[/b]
    - added a little more health to winter enemies
    - added more health to all winter bosses and also to some of summer ones.
    - Archer Boss arrow do more damage to soldiers
    - the falling fire and ice stones damage is slightly increased

Also fixed some rare bugs.


Greetings,
Twin Stone Studio
